The chart, drill and compose ran Studio with --bind 0.0.0.0 and no AMC_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, so the allowed list was [http://0.0.0.0:3212] and the probe's first native request (GET /api/v1/native-tasks/options) from Host <release>-amc:3212, 127.0.0.1:<port> or amc-studio:3212 was refused with NATIVE_HOST_DENIED. Round 2 listed this as unverified; it was verifiable offline and failed.
